extraction.Name: Rays Hernandez
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 160 acre allotment, when he got it, but that he was forced to take it
extraction.Buyer: Clements Velandry; agreed to pay up taxes and give $800.00 besides; paid $50.00 cash at time of deed, later paid $200.00, leaving $550.00 owing which has never been paid, nor has Velandry paid even the interest on this $550.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in taxes, and, in 1923, Clements Velandry came to him, and told him that he would pay up his taxes, and give him $800.00 besides, if Hernandez would deed him the land
extraction.Occupation/Income: he farms a little and works out at common labor, this being his only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, health not good, having had an operation for appendicitis; has a wife and eight children to support, the family being all healthy except three of the children; even if Velandry had paid him the $800.00, it would not have been a fair price for his allotment; has never received any help from the County, State or the United States Government; affidavit sworn November 23, 1928, Shannon County, South Dakota
